rationale: Mian is building agentic AI systems with a focus on payment and authentication, while Pranav leads AI solutions at Appsmith, a developer-tools platform. Their work in AI and shared TypeScript expertise create a natural fit for exploring how agentic systems could integrate into or extend developer tooling.
intro_message: Mian Majid, meet Pranav Kanade — you're both shipping in the AI space and could explore how agentic payment systems might complement developer-focused AI solutions.
